spoken_summary: Bill Maher states that "Democrats are cowardly" and that their party is being "taken over" by a "radical" element. He says he lost fans because he refused to go along with "crazy stuff on the left" and can't ignore it for the sake of team politics. He concludes by saying when people on his side are "cheering for the intifada... I gotta go, I'm out."

central_claim: Even a well-known liberal commentator like Bill Maher is now criticizing the Democratic Party as cowardly and too radical to support.
intended_effect: To validate conservative criticisms of the Democratic Party and persuade moderate or liberal viewers to reconsider their support for the party.
